html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display:ital@0;1&family=Albert+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');
  /* A Lisbon software company's site on a 76rem page: a header with its four routes and the hiring call, the story
     beside two overlapping photos on a band with the city's tiles, then values, process, people, history and
     certificates on alternating bands. DM Serif Display over Albert Sans. Looks: Azulejo (white and cobalt, the tile
     ornament faint behind the story, follows light / dark), Atlantic (deep sea, light moving over the story) and
     Tram 28 (cream, the tram's yellow and a fine diagonal). */
  #site-company {
    --background: oklch(0.99 0.003 250);
    --foreground: oklch(0.21 0.035 262);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.965 0.01 255);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.47 0.03 262);
    --border: oklch(0.21 0.035 262 / 0.11);
    --input: oklch(0.21 0.035 262 / 0.22);
    --primary: oklch(0.43 0.17 262);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.003 250);
    --secondary: oklch(0.95 0.02 258);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.35 0.14 262);
    --accent: oklch(0.95 0.02 258);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.35 0.14 262);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --radius: 0.75rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --co-band: oklch(0.965 0.012 255);
    --co-head: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif;
    color-scheme: light;
    container-type: inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      400 1rem/1.6 'Albert Sans',
      var(--font-sans);
  }
  #site-company > :is([data-company-view], .co-bar, .co-footer) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 76rem) / 2));
  }
  #site-company > [data-company-view] {
    padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.75rem);
  }
  #site-company > .co-band {
    padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem) !important;
    background: var(--co-band);
  }
  .dark #site-company[data-look='azulejo'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.19 0.03 262);
    --foreground: oklch(0.95 0.008 250);
    --card: oklch(0.225 0.035 262);
    --muted: oklch(0.25 0.035 262);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.76 0.025 255);
    --border: oklch(0.95 0.008 250 / 0.12);
    --input: oklch(0.95 0.008 250 / 0.22);
    --primary: oklch(0.74 0.13 258);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.19 0.03 262);
    --secondary: oklch(0.29 0.05 262);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.88 0.07 258);
    --accent: oklch(0.29 0.05 262);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.88 0.07 258);
    --co-band: oklch(0.215 0.034 262);
  }
  #site-company[data-look='atlantic'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.2 0.035 228);
    --foreground: oklch(0.95 0.012 200);
    --card: oklch(0.24 0.04 228);
    --muted: oklch(0.27 0.04 228);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.78 0.03 210);
    --border: oklch(0.95 0.012 200 / 0.12);
    --input: oklch(0.95 0.012 200 / 0.22);
    --primary: oklch(0.83 0.1 182);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.035 228);
    --secondary: oklch(0.3 0.05 205);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.9 0.07 182);
    --accent: oklch(0.3 0.05 205);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.9 0.07 182);
    --co-band: oklch(0.17 0.035 228);
  }
  #site-company[data-look='tram'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.975 0.018 88);
    --foreground: oklch(0.2 0.02 60);
    --card: oklch(0.99 0.012 88);
    --muted: oklch(0.945 0.025 88);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.44 0.03 60);
    --border: oklch(0.2 0.02 60 / 0.13);
    --input: oklch(0.2 0.02 60 / 0.25);
    --primary: oklch(0.82 0.16 85);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.02 60);
    --secondary: oklch(0.93 0.06 88);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.32 0.05 60);
    --accent: oklch(0.93 0.06 88);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.32 0.05 60);
    --radius: 0.375rem;
    --co-band: oklch(0.945 0.03 88);
  }
  #site-company .co-look-only {
    display: none;
  }
  #site-company[data-look='azulejo'] .co-look-only[data-for='azulejo'],
  #site-company[data-look='atlantic'] .co-look-only[data-for='atlantic'],
  #site-company[data-look='tram'] .co-look-only[data-for='tram'] {
    display: block;
  }
  /* the header (the Site Header block in the site's bar): the name, the routes at reading size, the look and the
     language */
  #site-company .co-bar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 88%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }
  #site-company .co-bar .mk-header-inner {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: 0.75rem 2rem;
    max-width: none;
    min-height: 4.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.75rem 0;
  }
  #site-company .co-brand {
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-company .co-brand .mk-header-name {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 400 1.625rem/1 var(--co-head);
    letter-spacing: 0;
  }
  #site-company .co-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem 1.75rem;
    margin-inline-end: auto;
  }
  #site-company .co-nav a {
    padding-block: 0.375rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-company .co-nav a:hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-company .co-nav a[aria-current] {
    color: var(--foreground);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary);
  }
  #site-company .co-bar-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #site-company .co-bar .select {
    min-width: 8rem;
  }
  /* the story: copy beside two overlapping photos, on a band with the look's texture */
  #site-company .co-hero {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    overflow: clip;
    background: var(--co-band);
  }
  #site-company .co-tiles {
    --surface-size: 72px;
    --surface-ink: oklch(0.43 0.17 262 / 0.06);
    --surface-bg: transparent;
    mask-image: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 30%, #000 75%);
  }
  #site-company .co-water {
    opacity: 0.55;
    mask-image: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 20%, #000 70%);
  }
  #site-company .co-stripes {
    --surface-size: 18px;
    --surface-ink: oklch(0.2 0.02 60 / 0.05);
    --surface-bg: transparent;
  }
  #site-company .co-hiring {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-block-end: 1.5rem;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem 0.375rem 0.625rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05);
  }
  #site-company .co-hiring::before {
    content: '';
    width: 0.5rem;
    height: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: oklch(0.68 0.17 150);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.68 0.17 150 / 0.2);
  }
  #site-company .co-hiring::after {
    content: '\2192';
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-company .co-hiring:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
    gap: 2.5rem;
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 3rem;
    align-items: center;
  }
  @container (width > 56rem) {
    #site-company .mk-about-intro-layout {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 0.9fr);
      gap: 4rem;
    }
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-eyebrow {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-company[data-look='tram'] .mk-about-intro-eyebrow {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-title {
    font: 400 clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.25rem)/1.02 var(--co-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-lead {
    max-width: 34rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.1875rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-facts {
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin-block-start: 1rem;
    padding-block-start: 1.75rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-facts dd {
    font: 400 2.25rem/1 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-facts dt {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  /* two photos: the street large, the desk smaller and in front, lower left */
  #site-company .co-hero .mk-about-intro-media {
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    aspect-ratio: auto;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 0 0 3rem 3rem;
  }
  #site-company .co-hero .mk-about-intro-media img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2);
    box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px oklch(0.2 0.04 262 / 0.45);
  }
  #site-company .co-hero .mk-about-intro-media img + img {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 42%;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border: 6px solid var(--co-band);
    rotate: none;
  }
  /* values: four cards with the icon in a tinted tile */
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-values {
    gap: 1.25rem;
    margin-block-start: 1rem;
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-values li {
    padding: 1.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-values li svg {
    box-sizing: content-box;
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    padding: 0.625rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--secondary);
    color: var(--secondary-foreground);
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-values h3 {
    margin-block-start: 1rem;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #site-company .mk-about-intro-values p {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* the process: big serif numbers on a rule */
  #site-company .mk-process-steps {
    gap: 2rem;
  }
  #site-company .mk-process-step {
    padding-block-start: 1.25rem;
    border-block-start: 2px solid var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-company .mk-process-step-number {
    font: 400 2.75rem/1 var(--co-head);
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-company[data-look='tram'] .mk-process-step-number {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-company .mk-process-step-title {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #site-company .mk-process-step-desc {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* the people: straight cards, room for the photo */
  #site-company .co-team {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr));
    gap: 2.5rem 1.75rem;
  }
  #site-company .mk-team-member {
    rotate: none !important;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  #site-company .mk-team-member-portrait {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.5);
  }
  #site-company .mk-team-member-photo {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    filter: none;
  }
  #site-company .mk-team-member-name {
    margin-block-start: 1rem;
    font: 400 1.5rem/1.15 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company .mk-team-member-role {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #site-company[data-look='tram'] .mk-team-member-role {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-company .mk-team-member-bio {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* history and certificates */
  #site-company .mk-timeline-item-title {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #site-company .mk-timeline-item-date {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #site-company[data-look='tram'] .mk-timeline-item-date {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-company .co-credentials {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 19rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }
  #site-company .mk-credential-item {
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  /* jobs and press */
  #site-company .co-jobs {
    display: grid;
    gap: 2.5rem;
  }
  #site-company .co-filter {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #site-company .co-filter .btn[aria-current] {
    border-color: var(--foreground);
    background: var(--foreground);
    color: var(--background);
  }
  #site-company .mk-job-group-title {
    font: 400 1.75rem/1.2 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company .mk-job-item {
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #site-company .mk-job-item-title a {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #site-company .co-press {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 18rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }
  #site-company .mk-press-item {
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #site-company .mk-press-item-publication {
    font-family: var(--co-head);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
  }
  #site-company .mk-press-item-quote p {
    font: 400 italic 1.25rem/1.4 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* the pages a list opens: a role, a case study, a press story - serif titles, the site's cards */
  #site-company :is(.mk-job-details-title, .mk-case-study-title, .co-story-title) {
    font: 400 clamp(2.25rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem)/1.05 var(--co-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #site-company :is(.mk-job-details-body, .mk-case-study-body, .co-story-body) h2 {
    font: 400 1.625rem/1.2 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company :is(.mk-job-details-summary, .mk-case-study-facts) {
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #site-company .mk-job-details-summary .btn {
    width: 100%;
  }
  #site-company .co-work {
    display: grid;
    gap: 2rem;
  }
  #site-company .co-work-title {
    margin: 0;
    font: 400 clamp(2.25rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem)/1.05 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company .co-work-lead {
    max-width: 38rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }
  #site-company .co-work-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 20rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
  #site-company .mk-case-preview {
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #site-company .mk-case-preview-title a {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 400 1.5rem/1.2 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company .mk-case-preview-metric strong {
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-company[data-look='tram'] :is(.mk-case-preview-metric strong, .mk-case-preview-more) {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-company .mk-case-study-results dd {
    font-family: var(--co-head);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  /* a press story: the outlet's quote large, what they wrote, the press contact */
  #site-company .co-story {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    max-width: 46rem;
  }
  #site-company .co-story-meta {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #site-company .co-story-meta strong {
    color: var(--primary);
    font: 400 1.25rem/1.2 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company[data-look='tram'] .co-story-meta strong {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-company .co-story-title {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-company .co-story-quote {
    margin: 0;
    padding-inline-start: 1.25rem;
    border-inline-start: 3px solid var(--primary);
    font: 400 italic 1.625rem/1.35 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company .co-story-body {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
  }
  #site-company .co-story-body p {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-company .co-back {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    width: fit-content;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-company .co-back:hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-company .co-back svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  /* previous and next under a page */
  #site-company .co-pager {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-block-start: 3rem;
    padding-block-start: 1.5rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-company .co-pager a {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-company .co-pager a:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-company .co-pager a + a {
    text-align: end;
  }
  #site-company .co-pager span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-company .co-pager strong {
    font: 400 1.25rem/1.25 var(--co-head);
  }
  /* the application: a dialog in the site's card colours */
  #site-company .co-dialog {
    width: min(94vw, 46rem);
    max-height: min(92dvh, 60rem);
    margin: auto;
    padding: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-2xl);
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
  }
  #site-company .co-dialog::backdrop {
    background: oklch(0.15 0.03 262 / 0.55);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  }
  #site-company .co-dialog-body {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    padding: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 2rem);
  }
  #site-company .co-dialog h2 {
    margin: 0;
    padding-inline-end: 2.5rem;
    font: 400 1.875rem/1.15 var(--co-head);
  }
  #site-company .co-dialog-x {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 1rem 1rem auto auto;
  }
  #site-company .co-dialog .mk-application-form {
    max-width: none;
  }
  #site-company .co-dialog .co-apply-done {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    justify-items: start;
  }
  #site-company .co-dialog:not([data-sent]) .co-apply-done,
  #site-company .co-dialog[data-sent] .co-apply-form {
    display: none;
  }
  #site-company .co-apply-done > svg {
    width: 2.5rem;
    height: 2.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--secondary);
    color: var(--secondary-foreground);
  }
  #site-company .co-apply-done p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* the footer: the Site Footer block on the site's band */
  #site-company .co-footer {
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--co-band);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-company .co-footer .mk-footer-inner {
    max-width: none;
